content: systemd user units for graphical daemons: use PartOf=graphical-session.target (not Requires=) + After=graphical-session.target; the target is only activated if the session manager does it (GNOME does); targets stay up after services stop so compositor restarts do not propagate; WAYLAND_DISPLAY/DISPLAY must be imported into the user manager (systemctl --user import-environment). Type=dbus is problematic for the engine: it only tracks names on the session bus systemd watches, while the goswitch engine lives on ibus-daemons PRIVATE bus; ibus-daemon itself spawns engines per component exec. Two supervision domains (systemd vs ibus-daemon) conflict: design must pick ibus-daemon as the engine supervisor (systemd unit optionally for a control/monitor sidecar or nothing).
